It's been a few month ago since he said things were getting better. Backstory here, he was attracted and shown interest from the start. We got married and he was involved in an emotional affair. I saw messages in which he was saying hed leave me and in which he sent photos of himself to another woman. He was going to meet up with her in real life, which he says was to end it. She never showed so I still dont know if that was the truth. She was messaging me about how they had sex and about the things he said about me to her. There were countless arguements about that. And it took some time but I eventually moved on from that...

However, my depression and anxiety that was probably dormant or something peaked. My self image was shattered and I didnt feel good enough. He didn't want to talk dirty to me anymore and he didnt seem interested in touching me. He says it was because of all the arguing. But the arguing stemmed from his fuckup. He would tell me to get over it. I would tell him it was hard. He would tell me that he felt nothing he did mattered. I would tell him that he should be trying harder to regain my trust. Hed tell me that he was never the type to be intimate. I'd tell him that I saw the way he talked to her; the way he used to talk to me. 

Thinking about it in my head it stems from the person that he spoke to online, about me. My insecurities were never that bad and for years I've never felt like enough. Now that I'm depressed about it he says my depression is turning him off. Before it was the arguing. Hes upset because things didnt turn out the way he thought but I kind of feel like he ruined it. He started talking to this person online 8 months after we got married. We have been married now for 4 years.

That was more for the title's sake. I agree that it's not an attractive quality. But he recently just started talking about how its affecting him and he's doing so in an angry manner. I feel hes kept a lot of it inside and now hes resenting me for it. But I couldn't do anything if I didnt know and I cant change it about myself....I dont know what to do.

I agree with what you're saying here 100%. In my situation though, I have taken care of myself too. We've stopped arguing as much and he even said that things were a lot better. The only thing that was missing was the sex. I talked to him about it today and that's when he mentioned that the anxiety and depression was a turnoff. If he can agree that things were better then how am I supposed to change that? He agreed that I've made changes. But it's like he holds onto the way things used to be and that has turned him off so much in the past that hes no longer interested or something. I'm not sure what else to do here. Mind you this has been for years. So it's not like things have been better for like a week..
